score.name: active_raw
score.transform: average rank within the current allocation pool, with context_id breaking allocation ties

allocator.definition: start every context at checkpoint four; consider at most floor(pool size times 0.125) highest-scored recipients; fund each checkpoint-six promotion by demoting lowest-scored nonrecipients to checkpoint two until both iteration and deterministic state-visit credits cover it; restore unnecessary highest-scored donors

runtime_charging.feature: charge a one-pass active DCFR regret summary after checkpoint two
runtime_charging.scheduler: charge rank construction and macro allocation
runtime_charging.solver: charge cumulative DCFR traversal time at the selected checkpoint

reserved_evaluation.fold_assignment: first eight SHA-256 bytes of group_id, big-endian, modulo five
reserved_evaluation.perfect_uplift_denominator: exact post-checkpoint-two pooled iteration oracle at average budget four
reserved_evaluation.test_policy: construct and evaluate test only if validation passes every gate; use this rule unchanged and apply the same gates
reserved_evaluation.validation_policy: apply this fixed rule once; do not select or retune on validation

failure_policy: retain fixed checkpoint-four DCFR; do not retune this rule
